topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
response: To mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band, adaptive beamforming techniques such as Dynamic Beam Training (DBT) and Multi-Beam Adaptive Array (MBAA) can be employed. These methods adjust the antenna's radiation pattern in real-time to compensate for changing channel conditions, ensuring a stable and efficient signal transmission.
reference_context: The context mentions high gain beams are used in mmwave bands to compensate large path loss, and narrower beams limit effective ray spread. It also discusses analog beamforming solutions requiring fewer RF chains than digital ones.
